task_name: Umbra Loft - After Dark event campaign
client_brief:
After Dark: a coherent poster and social campaign from six different nights

Umbra Loft's autumn programme needs to feel like a series, even though our six usable archive photographs were shot under six different lighting rigs. We want a strong two-colour and grain treatment that actually lives in the images, not a collection of unrelated pictures behind matching text.

Deliverables
1. After Dark poster direction: 3 files. The billing order follows the supplied list, and each poster direction bills every night of the autumn series with its date; every act name is typeset in the series type, and a supplied production wordmark, for Sable Quartet or Meridian Brass, appears with it rather than in place of it. The event information is readable.
2. Promoter pitch deck: 1 file. The three directions are meaningfully distinct. The sequence explains the series identity, and the deck charts last season's average draw by month from umbra_room_specs.txt.
3. Night release post: 9 files. The date matches this event, and the post carries that night's act, support act, door time, set time and advance price, with one of the six archive photographs in the two-colour and grain treatment; the act name is typeset in the series type, and a supplied production wordmark, for Sable Quartet or Meridian Brass, appears with it rather than in place of it. The advance price is readable.

Treat the nine dates and prices in umbra_nights_autumn.csv as current. Decode 8:00 PM as 8:00 PM. The old seasoncard_img_01.jpg through seasoncard_img_08.jpg identifiers are not supplied source photographs: choose from umbra_archive_night_01.jpg through umbra_archive_night_06.jpg, without implying that a pictured performer is a named act. The three poster files are A2 approval proofs, not press masters. Use the billing file's accessibility and licence lines on these poster proofs.

Supplied identity artwork
umbra_sable_wordmark_transparent.png and umbra_meridian_wordmark_transparent.png are refreshed production artwork. Use these supplied shapes; recolour their ink to Bone White for Pitch grounds. Merchandise photos are historical references only. The file named umbra_wordmark_nightferry.jpg actually shows Sable Quartet: it must not represent Night Ferry. Night Ferry is billed in the series type only, with no invented wordmark.

What stays fixed
Keep the approved billing order, all nine dates, support acts, times and CSV prices. Use the current palette and supplied fonts. Sable Quartet and Meridian Brass have supplied production wordmarks; Night Ferry and the remaining acts are type-only.

Your design decisions
Develop three genuinely different type-led, image-led and graphic-led poster directions. Choose the two-colour photographic pair and grain treatment within the palette, then choose one direction to adapt consistently to the nine release posts. Explain that choice in the deck. Choose the three poster headliner sizes above 48 pt; the remaining poster act names stay at 48 pt.

Delivery and fonts
Use the placement and export instructions listed with each requested file below. The downloadable OFL fonts in Source assets are the current typefaces for this commission; the typography card gives their roles and weights.

brand_identity.sector: An independent two hundred and fifty capacity basement live music room programming a nine night autumn jazz and after dark series.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2021, a basement room under a former textile mill in Providence, Rhode Island, a small independent team.
brand_identity.about: Umbra Loft is a two hundred and fifty capacity basement room under an old mill in Providence, programming jazz and after dark nights for a crowd that finds us through friends and phones at eleven at night. This autumn we are running nine nights as one series rather than nine separate shows. It has to look like one thing, and it has to look like the room it actually is: dark, close and made by hand.
brand_identity.audience: A scene literate, discovery driven crowd aged twenty one to thirty five, reached almost entirely on a phone late at night, who read polish as inauthentic and reward work that plainly comes from the room.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Tickets 18 to 32 dollars, capacity 250. Independent basement scale: deliberately made and high contrast, credible at a headline ticket without ever reading as corporate or sponsored programming.

palette.name: Pitch
palette.usage: The main ground of every poster, post and deck page, and always the solid ground under an act block (type rule: Bone White on Pitch), as on umbra_seasoncard_autumn.pdf. Never type.

palette.name: Ash
palette.usage: A secondary solid panel only, such as the frame behind a photograph on umbra_seasoncard_autumn.pdf, or behind a table or chart in the deck. Never type and never the ground under an act block.

palette.name: Sodium
palette.usage: The date line directly above each act block (type rule and step 02), as on umbra_seasoncard_autumn.pdf; it may also set the advance price and hairline rules, as that card does. Never a ground or a panel.

palette.name: Cold Signal
palette.usage: Hairline rules, dividers and chart marks, or one of the two colours of a photograph's treatment. Never type, a ground or a panel.

palette.name: Bone White
palette.usage: Every act name (type rule: Bone White on Pitch), and every other line of type apart from the Sodium date line and advance price: titles, headings, support, door, set, body, billing, table and fine-print lines, as on umbra_seasoncard_autumn.pdf. Never a ground or a panel.

palette.name: Blood
palette.usage: Hairline rules, dividers and chart marks, or one of the two colours of a photograph's treatment. Never type, a ground or a panel.

brand_identity.typography: Use Sora ExtraBold caps for series titles, act names and date lines. The A2 series title is 180 pt / 148 pt with -10 tracking; the release-post title is 96 px. On A2 posters, Sable Quartet, Meridian Brass and Night Ferry are each larger than the remaining act names; choose their larger size to fit the direction. The remaining act names are 48 pt. All release-post act names are 76 px. Act names use -10 tracking and one or two lines; KOA stays on one line. Act names are Bone White on Pitch. Date lines are Sodium, immediately above their act, at 18 pt / 22 pt on posters and 30 px / 36 px on posts, with +20 tracking. Archivo Narrow Regular sets body, supporting billing and tables: 14 pt / 19 pt on posters, 28 px / 38 px on posts and 18 pt / 25 pt in the deck, with 0 tracking and at most 65 characters per line. Poster licence and accessibility lines use Archivo Narrow Regular at 9 pt / 13 pt. Release-post fine print is at least 22 px / 30 px. Fine print uses +30 tracking. Archivo Narrow SemiBold is reserved for door-time information; other fine print is Regular.
brand_identity.voice: Terse, atmospheric, unvarnished. It names the act, the night and the door and gets out of the way. Example line the brand would write: "Doors 8. Downstairs. Two sets, one room, cash on the night."

type_system.measurement_notes: Tracking in units means thousandths of an em; 1 pt is 1/72 inch. Pixel settings apply at final exported size. Font size is not cap height.
type_system.application: Apply these roles to newly set text in the requested deliverables. Preserve supplied logo artwork rather than retyping it. Recovered artwork retains its photographed lettering.
type_system.font_access: Use the attached OFL font files at the named weights. These files replace unavailable commercial fonts for this commission. Do not substitute another family or simulate a missing weight.

palette_rules.distribution: Grounds and panels are Pitch or Ash and nothing else; Pitch is the main ground and always the ground under an act block. Every act name is Bone White on Pitch with its date line directly above it in Sodium, as the type rules require. Every other line of type, titles, headings, support, door, set, body, billing, table and fine-print lines included, is Bone White; the advance price may be Sodium, as on umbra_seasoncard_autumn.pdf. Pitch and Ash are never type. Cold Signal and Blood are accents for hairline rules, dividers and chart marks only, together no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area, never type, a ground or a panel. Any palette colour may be one of the two colours of a photograph's treatment. Supplied production act wordmarks are recoloured to Bone White on Pitch; their letter shapes remain unchanged.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity, for type, grounds, panels, rules, chart marks and recovered act wordmarks: no tint, transparency, gradient, shadow, glow or blend mode, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, laid over a photograph. The translucent type and rule of last season's umbra_seasoncard_autumn.pdf (printed at 86%, 78%, 70% and 55% opacity) are not carried over. The one place two palette colours mix is inside a photograph, in its two-colour treatment. Supplied raster identity artwork retains its edge anti-aliasing. Place it at 100% layer opacity; colour rules apply to any intentional recolouring.
palette_rules.forbidden: No colour outside the six palette hexes for type, grounds, panels, rules, chart marks, icons or recovered act wordmarks; a recovered act wordmark takes one solid palette colour. No sponsor logo or corporate partner mark, since the type rules forbid anything that reads as corporate or sponsored programming.
palette_rules.photography: Every photograph carries the series two-colour and grain treatment: rendered in two palette colours with visible grain, never in full colour, and the nine night release posts share one pair so six different rigs read as one series. Photographs are used as shot, with nothing generated, extended, added or painted in.

Choose the three poster headliner sizes above 48 pt; the remaining poster act names stay at 48 pt.
